A style for tile data

Source: R/providers.R
tile_style.Rd

Builds a style for tile data, with overrides. source is anything you could pass as style directly; use this function to override what is detected, or to get the style JSON to edit:

Usage

tile_style(
  source,
  type = NULL,
  tile_size = NULL,
  scheme = NULL,
  minzoom = NULL,
  maxzoom = NULL,
  attribution = NULL,
  source_layers = NULL,
  paint = list(),
  auth_token = NULL
)

Arguments

source

The tile data, as above.

type

"raster" or "vector"; detected when NULL (from the archive header, the TileJSON, the URL's extension, or one fetched tile).

tile_size

Raster tile size in px (default 256 for tile URLs and archives).

scheme

"xyz" or "tms" (rows counted from the south).

minzoom, maxzoom

Zoom range of the tiles (overzoomed beyond maxzoom).

attribution

Attribution text for the source.

source_layers

Vector tiles: the source layers to draw (default all).

paint

Vector tiles: a named list of paint properties for the generated fill-*, line-* and circle-* layers, e.g. list("fill-color" = "#cccccc"). Others are dropped with a warning.

auth_token

Optional access token for the tile service.

Value

The style JSON string.

Details

  • a tile URL template ({z}/{x}/{y}, {quadkey}, {bbox-epsg-3857}, WMTS {TileMatrix}/{TileRow}/{TileCol});

  • a TileJSON URL or file;

  • a PMTiles archive: URL, local path or pmtiles:// URL;

  • an ArcGIS .../MapServer (raster tiles) or .../VectorTileServer (its published style);

  • a style URL or file (returned with relative URLs made absolute).

Raster tiles get one raster layer. Vector tiles get a default style that draws every source layer (polygons as translucent fills, lines and outlines, points as circles, a colour per source layer) over a transparent background. The same function exists in Python (basemapper.tile_style()).

Examples

style <- tile_style("https://tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png",
                    maxzoom = 19, attribution = "© OpenStreetMap contributors")
style <- tile_style("https://example.com/tiles/{z}/{x}/{y}.mvt",
                    source_layers = "land", paint = list("fill-color" = "#e8e0d8"))
if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Detected from the data; also usable directly as `style`
tile_style("data/area.pmtiles")
basemap("data/area.pmtiles", 800, 600, bounds = nc)
} # }
